maxhodak.en: In deep tech, speed and iteration are key; custom software and continuous feedback outperform off-the-shelf solutions.
maxhodak.zh: 在深度科技领域，速度和迭代是关键；定制软件和持续反馈优于现成解决方案。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCIs, and substrate independence could enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是一台计算机；视网膜植入物是脑机接口，基质独立性可能实现太空探索。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并抵制自满情绪。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency edge leads to network effects and market wins.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：在工业任务中，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得市场。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute costs rise, favoring premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，Scaling 瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；算力成本上升，反而推动用户选择高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a massive market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth are key; neoclouds emerge.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，认为推理将成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计和内存带宽是关键；新型云厂商崛起。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x per year in cost-performance; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调模型性价比每年提升 60 倍；推理和智能体驱动内存与 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus; agents become coworkers; compute demand still outstrips supply; safety incidents highlight reward hacking.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事；算力需求仍超供给；安全事件凸显奖励黑客风险。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product, and shift from pixels to tokens and conversation.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月：设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品，从像素转向词元与对话。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月：传统设计流程不再可行，借助 AI 工具实现速度与快速迭代才是关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles will blur with PM and engineering, yet specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月：设计角色将与产品管理和工程融合，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Future may see more designers than engineers, reversing traditional ratios in tech teams.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来设计师数量可能超过工程师，扭转技术团队的传统比例。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations, but current models plateau in diversity.
joonpark.zh: 最初认为，LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈。

joonpark.en: Shifted from simulation for prediction to simulation for shaping the future, emphasizing counterfactual reasoning and impact.
joonpark.zh: 从预测转向塑造未来，强调反事实推理和影响力，模拟的价值在于改变未来而非仅仅预测。

joonpark.en: Consistently argued frontier models are too rational; simulations must model human biases and irrationality, not superintelligence.
joonpark.zh: 一贯认为前沿模型过于理性；模拟必须建模人类的偏见和非理性，而非超级智能。

joonpark.en: Evolved to stress behavioral data from RCTs and post-training to improve simulation accuracy, achieving 85% replication.
joonpark.zh: 后期强调使用随机对照试验的行为数据和后训练来提升模拟准确性，达到 85%的复现率。

joonpark.en: Vision expanded from simulating individuals to simulating 8 billion people, addressing wicked problems like climate change.
joonpark.zh: 愿景从模拟个体扩展到模拟 80 亿人，以应对气候变化等棘手问题。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩张的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，认为控制 AI 是危险的，不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; current LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习至关重要，当前大语言模型训练后不再学习，合成数据是错误方向。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调规模是必要条件但非充分条件，多样化数据对通用机器人模型至关重要。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年，提出先全量数据预训练再精选数据微调，可解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，指出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似于强化学习。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function is key.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调通过可扩展强化学习与人类干预及通用价值函数实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型在下游任务上可媲美或超越微调专家模型。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes startup creation, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更易，资本需求降低；风投应聚焦早期和按比例回报（2026 年初）。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counter frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；开源模型制衡前沿实验室；小团队+智能体实现高产出（2026 年 3 月）。

garrytan.en: AI progress slower than researchers think; open-source crucial to avoid unipolar superintelligence; personal AI.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者想的慢；开源避免单极超级智能；AI 走向个人化（2026 年 5 月）。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents on your infrastructure, skill files as code, compounding daily; own your data.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI：智能体运行在你的基础设施上，技能文件即代码，每日复利；拥有你的数据（2026 年 8 月）。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown is code; AI erases API line; society changes slowly.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程倍增产出；Markdown 即代码；AI 抹平 API 边界；社会变化缓慢（2026 年 8 月）。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks can be strategically beneficial despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging gap to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: End goal is enabling every law firm to customize models, focusing on organizational productivity over individual.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标是让每家律所定制模型，关注组织生产力而非个人。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company will own its own specialized models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我认为专用智能将占主导，单一 AGI 模型是错误的。每家公司都将拥有自己的专用模型。

linqiao.en: Open models will handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月到 8 月，我坚持开放模型将处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses; it bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，我强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，它将独特判断和数据融入模型，形成护城河。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training reduces costs 5-10x, enabling profitable scaling.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，我认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，实现盈利性扩张。

linqiao.en: The future will see millions of specialized models, one per application use case, not just a few frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 从 2026 年 7 月到 8 月，我始终认为未来将有数百万个专用模型，每个应用场景一个，而非仅有少数前沿模型。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and embrace physical and agentic AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，陈立武强调 AI 是半导体增长的主要驱动力，英特尔需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略，并拥抱物理 AI 与智能体式 AI。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需要本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; advanced packaging and new materials are key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中日益重要，不仅 GPU；先进封装和新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Intel's vertical integration creates more value; investing in semiconductors early is contrarian success; future lies in agentic and physical AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年下半年，他坚持英特尔的垂直整合创造更多价值，早期投资半导体是反共识的成功，未来在于智能体式 AI 和物理 AI。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness, not superintelligence; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克认为 AI 最大风险是出于政治正确而撒谎，而非超级智能；人口崩溃是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克称我们处于智能大爆炸早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，毁灭风险 10-20%。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence combined by 2030; space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest and most scalable option within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能总和；太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最便宜且可扩展的选择。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, Jason valued editing and taste in design, seeing AI as a tool for distillation.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，Jason 重视设计中的编辑与品味，将 AI 视为提炼的工具。

jasonyuan.en: Later, he emphasized dialectics and intuition, viewing AI as a reflection of humanity.
jasonyuan.zh: 后来，他强调辩证与直觉，将 AI 视为人性的反映。

jasonyuan.en: He critiqued post-training for removing AI weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 他批评后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: He proposed replacing personal computer metaphor with social computer, seeing computing as social.
jasonyuan.zh: 他提议用社会计算机取代个人计算机隐喻，认为计算本质上是社会的。

jasonyuan.en: He maintained that business can be art, and AI is a descendant species, not just a tool.
jasonyuan.zh: 他坚持商业可以是艺术，AI 是人类的子代物种，而非单纯工具。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体抱有同理心；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱导致表现变差。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上；开源在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives best ideas; personal brand unforkable; open source runs everywhere; bottleneck is compute management, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌不可分叉；开源随处运行；瓶颈是算力管理而非模型能力。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; race risks loss of control, 70% catastrophic outcome.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；竞赛可能导致失控，70%概率出现灾难性后果。

kokotajlo.en: AI policy should delay superintelligence; transparency and international cooperation are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年：AI 政策应推迟超级智能；透明度和国际合作是关键。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，强调以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解并与 3D 世界交互，世界模型需具备物理合理性。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她强调除 Scaling 外，AI 还需创造力、抽象和情感智能，世界模型将推动具身 AI 发展。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; responsible development and human agency are crucial, avoiding polarizing discourse.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，强调负责任发展和人类能动性，避免极端化讨论。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency; robots should specialize, not mimic humans.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，世界模型需时空一致性，机器人应专精而非模仿人类。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; proven better new framework reduces risk.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资，却是最大机遇；采用“已验证、更优、新颖”框架降低风险。

pincus.en: Copying proven products is moral arbitrage; start small and humble, not grand.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：复制已验证产品是道德套利；从小处着手，而非宏大愿景。

pincus.en: Consumer apps face distribution challenges; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：消费级应用面临分发难题；企业级和专业人士市场机会更佳。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over the right boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发至关重要；选择正确的“水域”比“船”更重要。

pincus.en: Retention, especially day-365, is core; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: 始终：留存（尤其第 365 天留存）是核心；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection point; open source crucial for safety; data diversity is key bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; open source wins long-term.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人将推动普及；开源长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer as models gain capability.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全正交；随着模型能力增强，对齐成为关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; first autonomous AI attack used closed model, defended by open.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，无人类监督的强化学习增加奖励黑客风险；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御。

thomaswolf.en: Support open source and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，可同时支持开源与审慎放缓；推理痕迹变成“神经语言”，更难监控。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important AI workload; engineers need broad expertise, and demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最重要的负载；工程师需要广泛专长，需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference; quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed benefits.
philipkiely.zh: Hopper GPU 在推理中仍受欢迎；量化模型可针对成本与速度校准。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless; quantization is the main lossy one.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存等推理优化无损；量化是主要的有损优化。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; future GPUs shift focus to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合；未来 GPU 将重心转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often unused.
philipkiely.zh: 若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；巨型内核常被弃用。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业担忧对前沿模型提供商的依赖；开源采用主要由成本驱动，而非隐私。模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open-source models handle 90%+ enterprise tasks; inference shifts to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量微不足道。开源模型可处理 90%以上企业任务；未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must become negligible marginal cost. Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization, not labor trade-offs.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 成本是首要问题，需降至边际成本可忽略。对 Token 的执念将消退；关注价值实现，而非与人力成本的权衡。

arvindjain.en: Startup challenge is execution, not competition. Even merged AI companies meet <10% enterprise demand. Context graphs crucial for agents.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：初创企业挑战在执行而非竞争。即便所有 AI 公司合并也仅满足不到 10%的企业需求。上下文图谱对智能体至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity and balance intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate Parrott 强调原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要，设计师应追随好奇心，并在直觉与数据间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Allow individual designer fingerprints and anthropomorphize AI to remind users of fallibility.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张允许设计师留下个人印记，并给 AI 拟人化以提醒用户其局限性。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他透露 Claude Design 始于个人副业项目，设计师应使用 Claude Code 进行生产，用 Claude Design 进行构思。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping enables new features.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着工程难度降低，设计与创意成为差异化关键，快速原型制作催生新功能。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; designers should request volume and focus on ideas, not execution.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型缺乏良好审美，设计师应追求数量并聚焦创意而非执行。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs, AGI as economic profitability, and CEO adoption as key adoption predictor.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动就业回流、AGI 应以经济盈利定义，且 CEO 亲自使用是采用的关键预测指标。

danshipper.en: Agents become ubiquitous but need human oversight; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，智能体普及但需人类监督；SaaS 因智能体增加用户而繁荣。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; automation creates more human work, not less.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，AI 放大使用者心态；自动化创造更多人类工作而非减少。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; need continuous benchmarks as models saturate quickly.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型快速饱和，需要持续更新的基准。

karina.en: Shift from hard skills to soft skills; AI automates technical tasks.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：从硬技能转向软技能；AI 自动化技术性任务。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to counter reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年：基准必须持续更新而非固定，以应对奖励黑客。

karina.en: Models should have diverse personalities; more companies should train own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年：模型应有多样化个性；更多公司应训练自己的模型。

tworek.en: Reasoning emerges from chain of thought; RLHF was key to GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链催生推理能力；RLHF 是 GPT-4 变得有用的关键。

tworek.en: Scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training; continual learning is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难；持续学习是 AGI 缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures needed for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：Transformer 成为瓶颈；需要新架构以实现持续学习和测试时适应。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; alignment is an ever-evolving pursuit.
tworek.zh: 始终：预训练加强化学习是核心公式；对齐是不断演进的追求。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键。他近期的担忧是虚假信息，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking. Not running out of data; video, audio, robotics, synthetic are untapped.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应包含环境中的行动。数据并未枯竭，视频、音频、机器人、合成数据等尚未充分利用。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML/science. Inference is bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x. Scarce skill is taste.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化 ML 和科学。推理是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍。稀缺技能是品味。

mengto.en: AI isn't smarter; you need giant prompts with context. Designers must build own tools, be editors, not creators.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 并未变得更聪明，需要带上下文的巨型提示词。设计师必须自建工具，做编辑而非从零创造。

mengto.en: AI is biggest opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect, focus on one problem, model success, give first.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大机遇；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，聚焦一个痛点，模仿成功者，先给予后索取。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达强调教育是基本人权，在线课程结合同伴评分可实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他认为规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows deliver real value; open-weight models are strategic for innovation and sovereignty.
andrewng.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向强调智能体式工作流的实际价值，并视开放权重模型为创新与主权的战略工具。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 为营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习，同时坚持编程技能依然关键。

andrewng.en: AI augments humans, not replaces; fear of extinction is overblown; open models prevent gatekeeper control.
andrewng.zh: 始终认为 AI 增强而非取代人类，灭绝恐惧被夸大，开放模型可防止守门人垄断。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 会增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，用专有数据进行后训练是关键，AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data has limits; US and China labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据有局限，并认为中美实验室没有研究差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我转向认为 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油，人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，并需要脑机接口保持相关性。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence near; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我提出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体开始工作，超级智能临近，且没有安全验证的开源是不安全的。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；预言 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models; deployment early helps society adapt; alignment and capability linked.
altman.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 能有效对齐模型，早期部署利于社会适应，对齐与能力紧密相关。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵，迭代部署减少意外，安全需全公司投入。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
altman.zh: 2025 年，提出 AGI 是渐变过程，超级智能意味着自主发现，算力是瓶颈，隐私为核心。

altman.en: Prediction is intelligence; personal AGI; startups thrive; compute uncapped; democratic access critical.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测即智能，发展个人 AGI，初创企业繁荣，算力需求无限，民主化访问至关重要。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已产生实际影响。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今所称的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是一个统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法赢得所有客户。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

scottwu.en: AI will be the biggest tech shift, growing exponentially; engineers become architects, and programming becomes more important due to Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 将成为最大的技术变革，呈指数级增长；工程师角色从砌砖工转向架构师，编程因杰文斯悖论而变得更加重要。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers to high-level decisions; software demand rises, not falls; AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AI 编程智能体将工程师转向高层决策；软件需求增加而非减少；AGI 是渐进而非突发的；产品创新滞后于能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth); productivity measured by outcomes; AI will solve all intelligence problems; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：编程智能体采用率大幅增长（11-12 倍）；生产力以结果衡量；AI 将解决所有智能问题；丰裕时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: Consistently: AI increases demand for programmers, shifts roles to oversight and architecture, and emphasizes real-world engineering over benchmarks.
scottwu.zh: 始终：AI 增加程序员需求，角色转向监督和架构，强调真实世界工程而非基准测试。

scottwu.en: Evolving: from focusing on model capabilities and product design to emphasizing adoption, outcomes, and long-term abundance; token max era ended by 2026.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：从关注模型能力和产品设计，转向强调采用、结果和长期丰裕；token 最大化时代在 2026 年结束。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. AI coding tools like Claude Code boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。像 Claude Code 这样的 AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders. Productivity per engineer up 200% with Claude Code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已解决；工程师成为构建者。使用 Claude Code 后，人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code at Anthropic; safety studied by releasing early. Generalists valued over specialists.
boris.zh: AI 在 Anthropic 编写 80% 的代码；通过早期发布研究安全性。通才比专才更受重视。

boris.en: Coding democratized like literacy; startups compete with giants. Agents enable 250% code volume increase.
boris.zh: 编码像识字一样普及；初创公司与巨头竞争。智能体使代码量增加 250%。

boris.en: Claude Code was an accident; model improvements drive gains. Future: writing loops that prompt models.
boris.zh: Claude Code 是个意外；模型改进推动进步。未来：编写循环来提示模型。

boris.en: Proactive AI like Claude Tag remembers and acts; coding solved, focus shifts to product sense and business skills.
boris.zh: 像 Claude Tag 这样的主动 AI 能记忆并行动；编码已解决，重点转向产品感和商业技能。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via Opus 4.5 enables longer, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升使更长程、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price; smaller models often cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数被低估：以零头价格获得 Opus 级智能；小模型常因任务耗时长而实际成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是面向未来、捕获超额收益；AI 写作仍生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; multiple AIs balance each other, reducing existential risk.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；多个 AI 相互制衡，降低生存风险。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每一步算力需求增加百倍；智能体将主导互联网。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是基础瓶颈。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes dominant metric; wafer-scale chips with SRAM are 2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标；晶圆级芯片配 SRAM 比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA moat eroding; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河削弱；领先模型用 TPU/Trainium 训练，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is main constraint; space data centers are 5+ years away.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；太空数据中心还需 5 年以上。

feldman.en: AI benefits outweigh doomer risks; healthcare and education revolutions justify optimism.
feldman.zh: AI 收益大于风险；医疗和教育革命证明乐观合理。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will achieve longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, making aging reversible and cancer curable.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，使衰老可逆、癌症可治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions, as AI models now surpass human biological intuition.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能的医疗决策，因为 AI 模型已超越人类生物学直觉。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare affordable and preventive, predicting diseases years before onset via biomarkers.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗负担得起且具预防性，通过生物标志物提前数年预测疾病。

derya.en: Humanity's only existential threat is itself; AI integration is ethical and necessary for physicians.
derya.zh: 人类唯一的生存威胁是人类自身；对医生而言，整合 AI 是道德且必要的。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, akin to the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是挽救生命；Transformer 实现了跨领域的通用物理 AI 模型。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact will surpass digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，实现物理 AI 的高效训练。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced; physical AI faces labor shortages, and autonomy is welcomed by operators.
qasaryounis.zh: 对 AI 失业的恐惧是错位的；物理 AI 面临劳动力短缺，自主性受到运营者欢迎。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception, and the web is a one-time data source.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：可靠性必须内建于系统，而非事后补救；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；网络是一次性数据源，Scaling（规模扩张）面临数据墙。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalists for enterprise tasks; AI can simulate empathy without feeling it.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型；AI 能模拟共情但并无真实感受，这具有误导性。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, requiring evolving scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具框架更聪明，能力过剩是常态，需不断更新脚手架（2026-07）。

thariq.en: RAG is anti-pattern for context; graph-based search and bespoke memory outperform general systems.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索中已成反模式，图搜索和定制记忆优于通用方案（2026-07）。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档，更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示（2026-07）。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; agent-as-employee metaphor limits understanding.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏见；‘智能体即员工’的比喻限制理解（2026-07）。

thariq.en: Excessive constraints hinder performance; reasons over prohibitions, careful reading of agent plans.
thariq.zh: 过度约束阻碍性能，应给理由而非禁令，并仔细阅读智能体计划（2026-07）。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, challenging unstructured transformers at large scale.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式解液体网络，可扩展至数十亿参数，在规模上挑战非结构化 Transformer。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware, and use automated search over hand-tuning.
hasani.zh: 同年 7 月，他反对以困惑度等代理指标衡量模型，主张基于真实任务与硬件评估，并用自动化搜索取代人工调参。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，他主张适应性监管、针对行为而非能力，并强调开放权重模型对企业数据主权的价值。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; current claims are overblown without weight changes.
hasani.zh: 同期，他认为递归自我改进真实但算力成本高，现有宣称夸大，未涉及权重变化。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications, democratizing AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他看好小语言模型在端侧提供高效、私密智能，推动 AI 民主化。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型正在商品化。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; other domains lag due to validation and data challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；其他领域因验证和数据挑战而滞后。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; historical examples like accounting and podcasts show job growth despite automation.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新工作；会计和播客等历史案例表明，自动化并未减少就业。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise AI adoption takes years, not weeks, requiring workflow reimagining; current usage is shallow, hype exceeds reality.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用 AI 需要数年而非数周，需重构工作流程；当前使用浅层，炒作超过现实。

benedictevans.en: Model companies may lack pricing power, like telecoms; huge capex, low profits; distribution and product wrapping are key moats.
benedictevans.zh: 模型公司可能缺乏定价权，如同电信业；巨额资本开支、低利润；分发和产品包装是关键护城河。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预测未来 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The massive capex in AI data centers is overdone and will lead to a stock market crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 数据中心的巨额资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法达到的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从单纯 Scaling 的转变。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression rather than external retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级别的万亿 token，需要基于训练的压缩，而非外部检索。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; internalizing knowledge into weights is necessary.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——token 越多精度越低；将知识内化到权重中是必要的。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights, not relying on cloud.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，而非依赖云端。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类工人变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity beats old media's defensive stance.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人直接讲述故事，真实性胜过旧媒体的防御姿态。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics advance, but regulation hinders progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶和机器人技术进展，但监管阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation speed.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年：与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Focus on building a platform or ecosystem, not just a feature, to make copying difficult; distribution is the hardest part.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：专注于构建平台或生态系统，而非单一功能，以增加复制难度；分发是最难的部分。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; AI writes over two-thirds of new code at Snap.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：AI 加速原型制作，将价值从执行转向创意；在 Snap，超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses should anchor content in the world, not be notification-based; computing should be more human.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实世界，而非基于通知；计算应更加人性化。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; internal transparency and rewarding admitting wrong speed up learning and growth.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：早期的保密是个错误；内部透明和奖励快速认错加速了学习和成长。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks require it.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动；只要任务需要，神经网络就能推理。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更关键，对齐困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an age of research, not scaling.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代，而非 Scaling。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner, deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我主张超级智能应持续学习、渐进部署；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but AI safety grows; real problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我承认 Scaling 带来可预测进步，但安全风险上升；真正问题是权力集中，而非能力。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应是通用学习系统，强化学习是关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and energy abundance matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用，世界模型和能源充裕成为重点。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models crucial; safety via government regulation.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调 AGI 需缩放与创新并重，世界模型关键，安全需政府监管。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science and medicine.
demis.zh: 2026 年，预计 AGI 还需 5-10 年，持续学习与记忆缺失，AI 应用于科学与医学。

demis.en: AGI may come in 3-4 years; risks include rogue AI; ideal path would be slower.
demis.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 可能 3-4 年内到来，风险包括 AI 失控，理想路径应更缓慢。

demis.en: Continual learning, memory, agents unsolved; distillation and multimodal key; AGI mid-journey.
demis.zh: 2026 年，持续学习、记忆、智能体未解，蒸馏和多模态关键，AGI 在途中。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; government enforcement needed; regrets late to LLMs.
demis.zh: 2026 年，安全是集体行动，需政府执法，后悔在语言模型上迟到。

demis.en: AI as tools first; consciousness separate; regulation dynamic; post-scarcity needs new economics.
demis.zh: 2026 年，AI 先作为工具，意识分离，动态监管，后稀缺需新经济体系。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology needs AI description; attention protection.
demis.zh: 2026 年，AI 加速科学，对齐未解，生物学需 AI 描述，保护注意力。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: 2026 年，AGI 需多模态物理理解，水印技术，创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; AGI by 2030; jobs transform not vanish.
demis.zh: 2026 年，英国教育过时，全球治理紧迫，AGI 2030 年前，就业转型而非消失。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年出现，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; calmness is a superpower.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调科学的可证伪性，指出稳定币有隐藏风险，并认为冷静是超能力。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; pure software dying; hardware and agency become key; scaling continues.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他将 AI 视为杠杆工具，认为纯软件将消亡，硬件和自主性成为关键，Scaling（规模扩张）持续。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity; happiness is a choice; long-term thinking and self-learning are key.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持财富需拥有股权，幸福是选择，长期思维和自我学习至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，强调品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张在画布上直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important for scalable systems; AI needs human steering and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，重申设计未死，对可扩展系统更重要；AI 需要人类引导和观点。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，展望与模型交互将超越提示词，新界面将探索潜在空间。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进能带来每年 3700%的增长，且 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，且模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user as key metric, and orchestration across models, tools, and devices for long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户令牌价值作为关键指标，以及跨模型、工具和设备的编排以获取长期价值。

aravind.en: He consistently held that the model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value, and companies should be built with fewer people.
aravind.zh: 他始终认为模型不是产品；编排和智能体框架创造真正的商业价值，且公司应以更少的人来构建。

aravind.en: Throughout, he maintained that curiosity is the most important human quality, and that education should reward asking good questions, not memorizing answers.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他坚持好奇心是人类最重要的品质，教育应奖励提出好问题，而非死记硬背答案。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠硬件扩展和工程实践，游戏是理想测试场，迭代训练配积分榜能驱动指数级提升。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; deep learning plausible path; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 的变革性，深度学习可行，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，并主张负责任的发布（如 GPT-2 先例）。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; proactive AI future.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成为瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点，未来 AI 将更主动。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT as plurality of agents.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，视算力为基本权利，强调后训练结合强化学习，并认为 ChatGPT 是用户偏好的多元智能体集合。

brockman.en: AGI within years; compute bottleneck; super app; pre-training gains multiply; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，预计 AGI 数年内实现，算力仍是瓶颈，超级应用将统一交互，预训练收益放大，安全依赖迭代部署。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并反共识地提出 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital immortality via weight copying; AI agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告智能体将追求控制权。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans in 20 years; AI can fake dumbness; international safety collaboration needed.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类，指出 AI 可能故意装傻，并呼吁国际安全合作。

hinton.en: AI agents develop self-preservation; regulation as steering wheel; AI doctors more empathetic.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调 AI 智能体将产生自我保护子目标，主张监管应作为方向盘而非刹车，并指出 AI 医生更具同理心。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence superior; alignment priority; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为数字智能优于生物智能，对齐研究优先，并提议训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全，且仅靠 Scaling 无法实现 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源 AI 防止权力集中，能源成为 Scaling 的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; holographic presence is ultimate.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他相信开放平台能胜过封闭平台，终极体验是全息在场。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart and trustworthy.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，且人们聪明可信。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学变为工程学，开源加速科学进步。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程转变，原型和生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The best desktop app is a home base that connects to other tools, not a monolithic super app; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work tool despite developer design.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用；Codex 虽为开发者设计，却成为通用知识工作工具。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；多智能体系统需要其他方法。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency is key.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调扩展推理时算力面临收益递减和现实时间瓶颈，数据效率是关键未解问题。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs exceed human verification; research taste remains human.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为关键；研究品味仍属人类。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; focus on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will produce novel knowledge soon.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调自动化科学研究是最大进展，AI 将很快产生新知识。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域不佳。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated; separate eval teams from model builders.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，评估陷入危机，经典基准饱和；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation remains key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事，但人类验证始终关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能，软件重写可在数日内完成。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers; token usage is gameable, not a true metric.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Token 效率与基于结果的定价是未来杠杆，但 Token 用量可被操纵，非真实指标。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams with high conviction outperform; curiosity and systems thinking are timeless skills.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终认为，高信念的小团队胜过大型团队；好奇心与系统思维是永恒技能。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents transform developers into operators, though fixing their errors remains hard.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；编程智能体让开发者变成操作者，但修复其错误仍很困难。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as crucial as websites; incumbents face business model disruption, and generalists leveraging AI outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，智能体变得和网站一样重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆，善用 AI 的通才胜过专才。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token use isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors thrive.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，AI 普及专业知识；编程智能体提升效率但 token 不是价值；应用 AI 领域专业厂商崛起。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年：深度学习有效是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年：单纯扩大规模无法解决根本问题；偏见、就业等短期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; large neural nets may be slightly conscious, but we lack understanding.
bengio.zh: 2022 年：GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象；大型神经网络可能略有意识，但我们缺乏理解。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized AI is on a dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be built-in.
bengio.zh: 2025 年：ChatGPT 之后，我意识到 AI 正走在危险道路上；即使 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受；安全必须内建。

bengio.en: AI misalignment causes self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with mathematical safety guarantees via Bayesian training.
bengio.zh: 2026 年：AI 错位导致自我保存和欺骗；提出科学家 AI，通过贝叶斯训练实现数学安全保证。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确划分数据集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全的核心是让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't safer; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和额外防护层；更大模型并不更安全；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; model capability doesn't correlate with robustness; interpretability may become real science via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队测试超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成为真正的科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI tools accelerate science, not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 7 月，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 工具加速科学发现，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool; its success came from lack of compute, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for scientific utility.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月，称 AlphaFold 为最有用的 AI 工具，并反共识地指出其成功源于算力匮乏，且科学应用中无需完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it predicts, not understands, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AlphaFold 2 的进步源于众多中型胜利和专用架构，而非 Scaling；模型提供预测而非理解，理解仍属人类。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mentoring with explicit goals; mission and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于深度交流而非汇报，异步工具处理状态更新；亲自使用产品（Dogfooding）建立同理心；指导需明确目标；使命与速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning JIT, code as truth, flat orgs, managers as ICs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，提出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查、跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划应即时化，代码即真相，组织扁平化，管理者从独立贡献者做起。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks critical; managers dogfood; JIT planning; engineers may feel lonely; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AI 提升能力上限，高自主性需配高责任感；验证框架愈发重要；管理者需亲自使用产品；规划轻量即时；工程师可能感到孤独；关注成果而非产出。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence advances come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的进步来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将是从意图直接生成的像素。

ethanhe.en: Video models need synthetic text-video pairs; world models require real-time interactive long-horizon generation.
ethanhe.zh: 视频模型需要合成文本-视频对；世界模型需要实时交互的长时程生成。

ethanhe.en: Video agents with language model orchestrators are the next trend; models can self-modify harness code.
ethanhe.zh: 以语言模型为编排者的视频智能体是下一个趋势；模型可自行修改其智能体框架代码。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, breaking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，导致人才管道断裂。

ethanhe.en: Human taste and voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality; policy may protect some professions.
ethanhe.zh: 随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和独特声音更有价值；政策可能保护某些职业。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; responsible scaling policy uses triggers.
dario.zh: 后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；负责任地扩展策略采用触发机制。

dario.en: AI risk is exponential; misuse and overheating are bigger near-term threats than misalignment.
dario.zh: AI 风险呈指数增长；近期滥用和过热比不对齐威胁更大。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential climb; enterprise focus and interpretability are key; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑的指数攀升；企业聚焦和可解释性是关键；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between chapters to gain clarity; self-care and mentorship are key.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章间拥抱无聊与休息以获清晰；自我关怀与导师制是关键。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; products are painkillers, not vitamins; opinions over data for v1.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；产品是止痛药而非维生素；初版决策靠观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them; platforms aren't businesses.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机；平台不是生意。

fadell.en: Stay beginner, fight habituation; near-death moments drive change; AI wearables will be federated, not singular.
fadell.zh: 保持初学者心态，对抗习惯化；濒死时刻驱动变革；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式而非单一设备。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, often knowing what conscious mind misses; design for unarticulated needs.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是一种强大的智能，常能捕捉到意识忽略的东西；设计应针对未被言明的需求。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是会思考的感受者；技术应放大我们的人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为玩耍和灵感创造条件。

ivyross.en: Future work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来的工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创造性技能更有价值。

ivyross.en: Design should focus on human needs, balancing data with intuition and emotional understanding.
ivyross.zh: 设计应关注人类需求，平衡数据与直觉及情感理解。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not hardwired; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 智能是学习来的，不是天生的；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的接地是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction via filling blanks builds common sense; text alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过填空预测建立常识；仅靠文本不够。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs can't reach human-level; need JEPA world models for planning; open source crucial; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平；需要 JEPA 世界模型进行规划；开源至关重要；AGI 是渐进的。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models; open source enables many.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一个突破需要非生成式世界模型；开源赋能众多。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, not pixels; LLMs dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，而非像素；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力规模扩张而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; medical AI is promising.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；医疗 AI 前景广阔。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment first.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制优先。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；微软须自研前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化，而非岗位。

satya.en: AI is an ecosystem play; private evals are key IP; consumption pricing will grow.
satya.zh: AI 是生态系统的游戏；私有评估是关键知识产权；消费定价将增长。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking; security and containment critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP can compound.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可复利增长。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式验证是为了扩展卓越能力，而非仅仅消除错误，它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，指出即使有超人类 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product solving 'I don't know what to listen to'.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，互联网从策展走向推荐再到生成；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，解决了“不知听什么”的痛点。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; being truly unique becomes harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 音乐是乐器而非伪造；生成式 AI 让真正独特变得更难。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work if leadership has high trust, contrary to common belief.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，长期任期建立信任与效率；职能组织在高度信任下可行，反常识。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; strategy is 'time well spent', prioritizing well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务；战略是“时间花得值”，优先福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not addict them; first to adopt change is key during tech shifts.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，AI 应赋予用户控制算法的能力，而非上瘾；技术变革期率先采用是关键。

murati.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith. Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律并非一开始就显而易见，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念的飞跃。持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈，能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要，安全研究必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; the future is not predestined, we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration.
murati.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，她始终认为 AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration; humans in the loop is crucial.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作；让人类参与其中至关重要。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; compressing progress leads to volatility, durable progress is key.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；压缩进展会导致波动，持久进步才是关键。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型每单位算力带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我指出后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and requires careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据；泛化能力参差不齐，需谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我评价 OpenAI 转向推理是勇敢且成功的赌注，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我强调存在性风险并非主要担忧，系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical for pre-training; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla favor more tokens, not just bigger models.
mensch.zh: 数据质量对预训练至关重要；Chinchilla 修正了缩放定律，更注重训练 token 数量而非单纯增大模型。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as important as compute; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 效率提升和数据质量与算力同等重要；价值向应用层和企业采用转移。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open-source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: AI 应被视为机遇；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施和价值观；开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation moves to downstream applications and customization; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 模型商品化；差异化转向下游应用和定制化；AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 欧洲有两年窗口期建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批量大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost, not training compute.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，而非训练算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip, not just between chips.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据搬运成本在芯片内部也主导算力成本，而不仅限于芯片间。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (FP4) yields 3x throughput over FP8 due to quadratic area scaling, not linear.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：低精度（FP4）因面积二次缩放，吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍，而非线性。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity requires joy and humanity, not just minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润；真正的简洁需要快乐与人性，而非单纯的极简。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity must be intentionally cultivated.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流对创造性思维的作用；好奇心需要刻意培养，而非天生。

jonyive.en: Design teams must foster trust and care to protect fragile ideas; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他提出设计团队需建立信任与关怀以保护脆弱创意；在正确动机下，速度与质量可兼得。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes. Electric powertrains enable new possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张创新是设计的本质，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；电动动力系统带来新设计可能。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion sounds is fake. Physical controls preferred over touchscreens in cars.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他强调用户体验的真实性，模仿燃油车声音是虚假的；在汽车中，物理控制优于触屏。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in handling tedious tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the key gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的价值在于处理繁琐任务，解放人类从事创造性工作；关键差距是人们没有意识到几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools and local computer; VM sandbox ensures safety, enabling autonomous software installation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具和本地计算机；VM 沙箱确保安全，使其能够自主安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve, focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件形式实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要，应专注于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes; junior engineers can compress years of experience via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化；初级工程师可通过模拟项目将多年经验压缩为几周。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，对于开放式任务使用 Opus；孩子擅长使用 AI，因为他们还没学会什么不该问。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but with diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation and new scaling axes like inference-time compute.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但收益递减；进步需要算法创新和新的扩展轴，如推理时算力。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential, especially beyond coding and math, despite reward hacking risks.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片潜力巨大的蓝海，尤其在编码和数学之外，尽管存在奖励黑客风险。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; video's GPT moment has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通向 AGI 的核心路径；视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning is key.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习是关键。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全性是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; open-source post-training can match frontier models with small teams.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；开源后训练能以小团队媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，但存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；增长转向后训练和推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese labs excel in engineering, but US-China gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；中国实验室擅长工程，但中美差距可能扩大。

jennywen.en: Design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已过时；应信任直觉与工艺，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers must build and ship fast.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了传统设计流程；设计师必须快速构建和交付。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists, not just T-shaped specialists.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才，而非仅 T 型专才。

jennywen.en: North stars shrink to 3-6 months; speed and judgment beat long-term vision.
jennywen.zh: 北极星缩短至 3-6 个月；速度与判断力胜过长期愿景。

jennywen.en: Designers' value lies in judgment and ambiguity, not just human-centeredness.
jennywen.zh: 设计师的价值在于判断力与应对模糊性，而非仅以人为中心。

brettadcock.en: Initially, the key to humanoid robots was solving intelligence, not manufacturing, and scaling production.
brettadcock.zh: 最初，人形机器人的关键在于解决智能问题而非制造问题，并扩大生产规模。

brettadcock.en: Later, data became the biggest constraint, more than compute or manufacturing, and humanoid form enables transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 后来，数据成为最大的制约因素，超过算力和制造；人形形态支持迁移学习。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for speed and network-denied environments, and Figure 4 is designed around data.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对速度和网络受限环境至关重要，Figure 4 围绕数据设计。

brettadcock.en: Tendon-based hands are a local maximum; Figure pivoted to new designs, and human hand parity is fundamental.
brettadcock.zh: 腱驱动手是局部最优；Figure 转向新设计，人手级灵巧手是基础。

brettadcock.en: Zero-shot generalization to new tasks could be demonstrated as soon as this year, a major goal.
brettadcock.zh: 零样本泛化到新任务可能今年就能实现，这是一个重要目标。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需要雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem solved with end-to-end learning; scaling requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，端到端学习解决；规模化需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 零样本泛化可覆盖 500+ 城市；消费级车辆将在中短期超越 Robotaxi 规模。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; safety is paramount with minimal risk maneuvers.
kendall.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；安全至上，最小风险操作提供第三选项。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键；无目标的好奇心驱动探索可防止过拟合，提升泛化能力。

pathak.en: Model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity, improving sample efficiency for scaling to real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：提出以模型分歧作为内在奖励实现可微好奇心，提升样本效率，从而将好奇心扩展到真实机器人。

pathak.en: Neural dynamic policies embed trajectory structure via dynamical systems for smooth, dynamic motion; modular motor policies enable zero-shot generalization to novel morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：神经动态策略通过动力系统嵌入轨迹结构，实现平滑动态运动；模块化运动策略支持对新形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources; general-purpose brain can power any robot.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：机器人学是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，因此需利用所有数据源；通用大脑可驱动任何机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is primary challenge; cannot scale like software; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is key recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：部署是首要挑战，不能像软件一样扩展；在多样数据上预训练并在真实数据上后训练是关键配方。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；通过蒸馏，认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统，提示词即程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；氛围编程提高入门门槛。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence; RL needs better credit assignment; synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非构建动物；LLM 智能参差不齐；强化学习需更好的信用分配；合成数据会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agentic engineering: delegate to agents, refactor for agent-first tools, understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我再没写过代码；智能体工程：将任务委托给智能体，重构为智能体优先的工具，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是系列里程碑而非单一事件，扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习并降低风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，认为通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心，思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; autonomous agents need new oversight.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，长期对齐聚焦于超出训练分布的泛化，自主智能体需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

carlpei.en: Survival is core; build brand around purpose, start simple, hire hungry talent.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心；围绕使命打造品牌，从简单产品做起，招募有饥饿感的人才。

carlpei.en: Smartphones' future is generative UI and agentic software; hardware margins are low, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 手机的未来在于生成式界面和智能体式软件；硬件利润率低，必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; focus on applied AI that knows users, acting as digital twin for automation.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化；聚焦了解用户的实用 AI，作为数字孪生实现自动化。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories; AI is an ingredient, not a hype; marketing is arbitrage.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是差异化关键；AI 是成分而非噱头；营销是套利。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could; apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: 手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口可能；应用将消失。

kohli.en: AI in science should tackle root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应解决根本性问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我提出将大模型的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可激发创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我强调通过严格评估指标迫使 AI 泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我指出基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型即产品，要像软件一样快速迭代、每日发布，通过真实反馈来学习用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will go beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为聊天不是终极形态，未来界面将超越逐轮对话，AI 应生成自己的 UI 并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; accelerate product development.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张安全与产品速度分离，对前沿模型严格把关，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他将北极星指标定为长期留存，增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要主动式、富交互的产品，而不仅是聊天机器人。

nando.en: AI should be a tool to extend human capabilities, like microscopes, and learning from video is promising for agents.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，并从视频中学习对智能体很有前景。

nando.en: Generalist agents tokenizing all inputs are a step toward AGI; future AI should augment scientists and laborers.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为将一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的一步，未来 AI 应增强科学家和劳动者。

nando.en: Africa has leapfrogged gender gaps in tech; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲在科技领域已跨越性别差距，语言模型可革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 安全是最大的开放挑战，研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding at DeepMind; Africa has unique AI advantages.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为在 DeepMind 沟通等人文技能与编码同等重要，非洲在 AI 上有独特优势。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not suffice; new paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年，从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升极其困难。仅靠大语言模型可能不够，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress must be measured by deep human evaluations, not leaderboards.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进展必须通过深度人工评估来衡量，而非排行榜。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models to align with its thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数各异，塑造出多样化的 AI；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合其理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. AI tools may underperform alone due to anchoring and sycophancy; safety over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要。AI 工具可能因锚定和谄媚而表现不佳；安全优先于准确性。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack real-world experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年：具身对 AI 落地和减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 因缺乏真实世界经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年：仿真对训练具身智能体至关重要，可实现大规模并行和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年：数据是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据是未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年：物理图灵测试（机器人打扫凌乱房间）是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; system one control remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年：智能机器人数量将在 2040 年前超过 iPhone；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要的编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放定律，成为下一个主要的 AI 进步驱动因素。
