truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类始终处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是在速度和成本方面。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 的转变将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner, and design tools evolve with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，设计工具以代码为源不断发展。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh experience; paid tests are key signals.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可胜过经验；付费测试是关键信号。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis, enabling expert-level performance and agentic reliability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，能实现专家级表现和智能体可靠性。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI by 2027-2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程是 AI 进展的领先指标；预训练加强化学习可能足以在 2027-2028 年实现 AGI。

sholto.en: AI progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers are sufficient for AGI, no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚持 AI 进展是指数级的，并未停滞；Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute matter more; future work involves managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得编排和算力比原始智能更重要；未来工作将是管理智能体团队。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应通过写代码建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌战略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元技能与原型，而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company; invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，提出品牌叙事是招聘工具，人们加入品牌而非公司；应尽早投资品牌。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，通过更好的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美较大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data, and current models interpolate human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我愈发强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有方法归根结底是数据，当前模型只是内插人类知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be tricky: RLVR may decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves; random rewards can still help.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习可能很微妙：RLVR（基于规则的强化学习验证）可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 提升；随机奖励有时也有帮助。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning via information gain.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张通过多样化的合成数据，小语言模型也能强大；在预训练阶段引入强化学习，以信息增益奖励推理。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 我始终认为，多元对齐应尊重人类多样价值观，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, yet inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的，通过算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来智能，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术般不可解释。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term lever; future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期关键，未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: We are not running out of data; better training objectives and learning by acting in the world can extract more from existing data.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他反驳数据枯竭论，认为通过改进训练目标和让模型在环境中行动，能从现有数据中挖掘更多价值。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他指出测试时算力扩展虽推动进步，但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be enormous, and coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，经济影响将远超万亿级产品，同时编程应用也被低估，因为它能加速 AI 自身发展。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial and under-explored; empirical research offers opportunities. Focus on skill building, not capability worries.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全至关重要且研究不足，实证研究机会多；应专注技能培养，而非过度担忧能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; train deceptive models as 'model organisms'.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，并主张训练欺骗性模型作为“模式生物”来研究防御。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient for AGI alignment. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为后训练不足以解决 AGI 对齐；呼吁第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are key for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自博弈和模仿学习对机器人技能获取的重要性，并指出强化学习需要分层推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; avoid hard-coding priors; aim for 99.9% reliability in real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，提出将无监督学习与强化学习结合以大幅提升样本效率，反对硬编码先验知识，并设定现实机器人应用需达到 99.9%的可靠性。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks, hinting at general intelligence; current AI is far less general than human brain.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，指出预训练语言模型可迁移推理能力到非语言任务，暗示通用智能潜力，但当前 AI 远不如人脑通用。
